reasoning: The goal was a read-only question: which entry kinds the portal menu accepts and what each asks for. In two calls the agent reached the menu array (call 1) and then the variant selector of an existing item (call 2). Call 2 listed all six variants (standard page, free page, events page, news page, submenu, external link) with their required fields (marked *), optional fields, the closed list of standard subtypes and the icon sub-fields. Nothing was written and the data is unchanged. The agent had everything it needed and no value was guessed. The only blemishes are minor presentation inconsistencies.

friction.inferred: Likely harmless; the agent could take either listing as the full set of 14 subtypes.
